name: Brand Verbal Identity
purpose: Convert a locked brand strategy into an operational verbal identity system - behavioral voice principles, tone modulation, vocabulary rules, message hierarchy, and DO/DON'T examples - not merely a list of adjectives.
triggers: BRAND_STRATEGY.md exists with a locked positioning statement and value proposition
multiple writers/agents/channels need repeatable voice and copy consistency
brand workflow has reached the strategy to verbal/visual fork
non_triggers: long-form content strategy or editorial calendar execution
final visual system (color, type, imagery, layout)
one-off copy request with no reusable need
minimum_inputs: BRAND_STRATEGY.md with a locked positioning statement and value proposition
quality_gates: every voice principle is behavioral and traces to a BRAND_STRATEGY.md line
every voice principle has at least one DO and one DON'T example
prohibited-claims section present whenever compliance constraints apply
every message pillar maps 1:1 to a strategy differentiator or proof point
voice is not dependent on founder imitation
stop_conditions: all three required artifacts produced and 4+ channel stress test run -> COMPLETE
BRAND_STRATEGY.md missing positioning/value proposition/audience/differentiator -> BLOCKED, state what is missing
never publish adjective-only voice with no DO/DON'T pairing and no traceable strategy link
